content.short: Supra helps merchants create online checkout pages for products and services without writing any lines of code.
content.description:
Supra helps merchants and creators on Cardano by providing a way to create checkout links for their products and services without writing any lines of code.

Merchants: Merchants can add information about products they wish to sell, choose which customer information they wish to collect, and can choose to track inventory if necessary. Once the product information has been added, they can create checkout links for their products. Directing customers to the checkout links is as easy as setting hyperlinks on your website/marketing materials.

Customers: Supra's checkout links are designed to be easy for customers to use, and allow payments to be made with most popular Cardano browser wallets.
